policy: APPEND-ONLY (owner instruction 2026-08-17: 'Keep the source re-pin append-only as a new generator implementation/version; never replace the historical pin'). Each source carries an ordered list of AUTHORIZED generator implementation versions. A re-pin APPENDS; it never rewrites or deletes an earlier entry, because registered forecasts bind the sha of the implementation that produced them and those bindings must stay resolvable forever. `current` is always versions[-1].sha256 and is the only version permitted on disk. v1 of this file (a flat path->sha map) was replace-in-place; the history below was reconstructed from that file's own git history, so no version was lost.

IMPL v1 — initial registration. Date-ordered OOF ablation of team form (FULL / STALE / NO_FORM) on paired Brier and log-loss, per owner caution 2026-08-17: 'To establish that form is useful — not merely active — run a date-ordered OOF ablation comparing form vs no-form on paired Brier/log-loss.' Imports v13_sim/load_rows/_sp from the pinned harness/run_v13_historical.py; contains no transcribed sim math.

IMPL v2 — added stratification of the FULL vs NO_FORM contrast by how many prior games the weaker-supported side's form rests on (counted from the same frozen file, strictly before the row, so leak-free). V13 applies rf/LG_RPG with NO shrinkage, so the pre-registered prediction was that damage concentrates where support is thinnest; a flat profile would have refuted it. Analysis addition only: no arm definition, seed, sim call or metric changed, and the pooled figures are byte-identical to impl v1's run.

IMPL v1 — initial registration. Three-state decomposition separating the 2026-08-13 interior-hole repair from the 2026-08-15/16 tier-1 refresh, which the registered v2->v3 contrast bundles together because one intake applied all 39 rows. Form states are built by DATE FILTER over the canonical results file in memory; the file is never mutated. Refuses to report unless the reconstructed states reproduce the REGISTERED v2 and v3 card probabilities exactly. Owner instruction 2026-08-17.

IMPL v2 — corrected an inverted boolean: pitcher_form.changed_by_this_refresh was emitting 'not _sp_changed', so a field-by-field comparison finding ZERO starter differences was reported as CHANGED. The underlying verification and every probability figure were unaffected; only the summary flag was wrong. Caught by reading the emitted artifact rather than trusting the code path.

IMPL v3 — owner correction 2026-08-17: the '81% of total' attribution was invalid. It divided a per-path mean |delta| by the NET mean |delta| (different denominators), and mean absolute movements are non-additive because signed per-game contributions cancel. Adds a fourth form state S_D (all dates except the hole date) so both factor orderings exist, then reports GROSS path shares and order-neutral two-factor SHAPLEY values with per-game signed contributions and the interaction term. Selftest now asserts phi_R + phi_H equals the net signed change to 1e-12 per game and that gross >= net.

IMPL v4 — pins S_C (and S_D) to CUTOFF_C = 2026-08-16 instead of 'all dates'. S_C is the form state the v3 card was BUILT on; writing it as 'all dates' was true only until 8/17 results were ingested, after which the state silently grew a day and stopped reproducing the registered card. An as-of state must be pinned to its date, not to whatever is on disk.

IMPL v1 — initial registration. Renders a registered card as model output in betting units (fair ML, fair run line, per-side projected score, model total, one-run/extra-inning/blowout probabilities, K expectations). Contains a verbatim transcription of daily_card.py sim() to recover per-side score means the stored card does not keep; refuses to render unless the replay reproduces all six stored V13 fields exactly on every game. Owner instruction 2026-08-17: cards must carry model predictions/output.

IMPL v2 — AS-OF FORM FIX. The replay used the CURRENT results file, but a card dated D was built by daily_card from results strictly BEFORE D. Once 2026-08-17 finals were ingested the replay silently included that day's own results (look-ahead) and stopped reproducing the registered card: STL@CIN home_wp moved 0.452 -> 0.456. Now filters results.csv to date < the card's slate date. Caught by the module's own refuse-on-mismatch gate the moment the finals landed.

IMPL v1 — the one-shot V14 starter-shadow runner, written AFTER the prereg was frozen at commit 8855503 (sha 9cb65230) and implementing exactly it: closed 6-feature vector, fold-internal standardization + inner-split ridge selection, four comparators on identical games, date-block bootstrap + Holm. Refuses to fit against drifted prereg bytes; refuses a second fit while a valid result exists. Includes the serialization fix (numpy bool casts) applied after the first run crashed writing its output; the partial was quarantined, not deleted, and the deterministic refit reproduced the identical numbers.
